title: 第19章 金刚不坏身第20章 我有一卷清静经
slug: 长生从守书阁的太监开始
lines: 一月时光，倏忽而过。
书阁小屋内，李叶青缓缓收功，周身气血平复，眼中精光内敛。
他感受着体内澎湃的气血和那六处已彻底贯通、如同漩涡般缓缓汲取周身精气的穴窍，心中一片澄明。
【混元功·残&nbp;v3（大成·499500）】
“只差最后一道穴窍，便可尝试冲击气海境了。”
他轻吐一口浊气，感受着实力稳步提升带来的踏实感。
莲公主提供的“赤血益气丹”效果卓著，加上他日夜不辍苦修《混元功》，进度远超常人想象。
然而，越接近圆满，他越能感到那层瓶颈的坚固，最后一道穴窍的冲击，绝非易事。
就在他凝神内视，规划着最后冲刺时，脑海中那沉寂许久的解析系统，终于传来了期盼已久的提示音
【《金刚般若波罗蜜经》解析完成！】
【获得炼体法门金刚不坏身】
来了！
李叶青精神一振，立刻将心神沉入识海。
只见一段玄奥晦涩、却又带着某种坚不可摧意蕴的法诀，如同烙印般清晰呈现。
与之相伴的，还有无数关于运气、淬体、观想金刚法相的细节与图像，如同醍醐灌顶，让他瞬间明悟了这门功法的根本精义。
“金刚不坏身……竟然是这门传说中的佛门横练功法！据看过的杂谈上所说，即便是佛门圣地大相陀寺也只有残片啊！”
他心中涌起一阵惊喜。
此法并非直接提升内力修为，而是专注于淬炼肉身皮膜、筋骨脏腑，练至大成，可令身躯坚若金刚，力大无穷，寻常刀剑难伤，更能硬抗内家真气的冲击！
这正是他目前急需的护身手段！
修道高深之处，立地就是罗汉金身！
最重要的是，佛门功法，若是只修其法，不念其经，往往会事倍功半，说不得还有走火入魔的风险。
但自己却全无这些担忧，因为解析完之后，他对于《金刚经》的理解，已经比得上当世的高僧大德！
《混元功》主修内息，注重内息与血气的浑厚，但却并无直接搏杀的手段。
这《金刚不坏身》恰好弥补了短板！
只是随着深入琢磨，李叶青很快冷静下来，眉头微蹙。
因为他敏锐地察觉到，这《金刚不坏身》的运气法门与行功路线，与《混元功》乃至《太上炼神诀》的道家路数，存在着一种隐隐的排斥感。
佛门功法，大多刚猛霸道，讲究以力证道，气血运行如烈火烹油；而道门玄功，则偏向中正平和，绵延悠长，炼气化神。两者虽非水火不容，但若同时修炼，一个不慎，极易导致气血冲突、内力紊乱，甚至损伤经脉。
“果然，佛道双修，绝非易事。”
李叶青喃喃自语，眼中闪过一丝凝重。
这《金刚不坏身》虽是绝佳的护身法门，但如何与自身根基的《混元功》协调共存，却成了摆在眼前的难题。
“看来，必须先解决这功法冲突的问题，才能修行，不过以我如今的境界，是绝对做不到的。
或许……需要找到某种中和调和的法门，或者，需要将《混元功》修炼到更高境界，以其更为精纯平和的内息为根基，再来尝试驾驭这佛门刚猛之力？”
他沉吟片刻，心中已有决断“眼下，还是以稳固当前修为，冲击最后穴窍为首要目标。
《金刚不坏身》的修炼，暂且记下，待日后寻得解决之道，或境界更高时再行尝试。贪多嚼不烂，根基稳固方是正道。”
content_en:
January passed by in a blink of an eye.
In the Shuge hut, Li Yeqing slowly finished his exercises, his energy and blood all over his body calmed down, and his eyes shone calmly.
He felt the surging Qi and blood in his body and the six acupuncture points that had been completely connected and slowly absorbed the essence of the whole body like a whirlpool, and his heart became clear.
[Hunyuan Gong·Zan&nbp;v3 (Dacheng·499500)]
"There is only one last acupoint left before we can try to attack the Qi Sea Realm."
He took a breath and felt the sense of security brought by the steady improvement in strength.
The "Red Blood Qi Replenishing Pill" provided by Princess Lian is very effective. In addition, he has been practicing "Hunyuan Gong" day and night, and the progress is far beyond ordinary people's imagination.
However, the closer he got to perfection, the more solid he could feel the bottleneck. The impact of the last acupoint was by no means easy.
Just when he was looking inwards and planning the final sprint, the long-awaited notification sound finally came from the analytical system in his mind that had been silent for a long time.
[The analysis of "Vajra Prajnaparamita Sutra" is completed! 】
[Obtain the body refining method and the indestructible Vajra body]
Coming!
Li Yeqing perked up and immediately sank into the sea of ​​consciousness.
I saw a mysterious and obscure method, but with some indestructible meaning, clearly presented like a brand.
Along with it, there were countless details and images about luck, body tempering, and visualizing the Vajra Dharma. It was like an enlightenment, allowing him to instantly understand the fundamental meaning of this technique.
"The Vajra Indestructible Body... turns out to be the legendary Buddhist horizontal training method! According to the gossip I read, even the Buddhist holy land Daxiangtuo Temple only has fragments!"
There was a surge of surprise in his heart.
This method does not directly improve the internal strength, but focuses on tempering the skin, muscles, bones and organs of the body. When practiced to perfection, it can make the body as strong as a diamond, with infinite strength, difficult to be hurt by ordinary swords, and even more able to withstand the impact of internal energy!
This is exactly the means of protection he urgently needs right now!
Wherever you practice the Tao, the golden body of Arhat will stand!
The most important thing is that if one only practices the Buddhist techniques without reciting the sutras, he will often get twice the result with half the effort, and there is a risk of becoming possessed.
But he had no such worries, because after analyzing it, his understanding of the Diamond Sutra was already comparable to that of the eminent monks and virtuous men of the time!
"Hunyuan Gong" focuses on inner breath, focusing on the richness of inner breath and blood, but there is no direct means of fighting.
This "Indestructible King Kong" just makes up for the shortcomings!
But as he pondered deeply, Li Yeqing quickly calmed down and frowned slightly.
Because he was keenly aware that there was a faint sense of repulsion between the luck method and practice route of "The Vajra Indestructible Body" and the Taoist methods of "Hunyuan Gong" and even the "Tai Shang Shen Refining Technique".
Most of the Buddhist Kung Fu are fierce and domineering, emphasizing the use of strength to realize the Tao, and the movement of Qi and blood like burning fire cooking oil; while the Taoist Xuan Kung is more neutral, peaceful, long-lasting, refining Qi and transforming into God. Although the two are not incompatible, if they are practiced at the same time, if one is not careful, it can easily lead to conflicts between qi and blood, internal energy disorders, and even damage to the meridians.
"Sure enough, cultivating both Buddhism and Taoism is by no means easy."
Li Yeqing murmured to himself, a trace of solemnity flashed in his eyes.
Although this "Vajra Indestructible Body" is an excellent self-protection method, how to coordinate and coexist with the "Hunyuan Gong" that is one's own foundation has become a difficult problem before us.
"It seems that the problem of conflicting skills must be resolved before we can practice, but with my current state, it is absolutely impossible.
Perhaps... we need to find some kind of method of neutralization and reconciliation, or we need to practice "Hunyuan Gong" to a higher level, based on its more pure and peaceful inner breath, and then try to control this fierce power of Buddhism? "
He pondered for a moment and made a decision in his mind: "Right now, the primary goal is to stabilize the current cultivation level and attack the last acupoint.
I will write down the practice of "Indestructible Body" for the time being, and try again when I find a solution in the future, or when I reach a higher level. To bite off more than you can chew, only by having a solid foundation is the right path. "
title_en: Chapter 19 The Indestructible Body of Vajra Chapter 20 I have a volume of Jingjing Sutra
